capabilities: sync recent activities from Garmin Connect or the Strava API
import FIT files, individually or zipped, from Garmin, COROS, Wahoo, Polar and Suunto devices
import historical activities from a Strava bulk export CSV
generate note paths, content and frontmatter from Handlebars.js templates
estimate calories from heart-rate or power data and expose fields as properties for Dataview
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed via BRAT or manually. Secrets are stored in Obsidian's secret storage on 1.11.4+ and must be set up per device. The same activity imported from Strava and Garmin/FIT creates two notes because IDs differ.
intentEvidence: It started as a fork of Strava Sync by Howard Wilson, and is released under the same MIT license.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring fitness activity data from services or device files into the vault as structured notes.

relations.evidence: It started as a fork of Strava Sync by Howard Wilson
Customizable properties / front matter allowing for Obsidian Dataview integration
Per-sport icons for use with Iconize
This example requires that the Contribution Graph plugin first be installed and enabled.

requires.name: Strava API application or Garmin Personal API key
Strava subscription (required for Strava API access since June 2026)
BRAT for installation; Dataview, Iconize, Charts, Contribution Graph for integrations

summary: Workout importer that syncs activities from Garmin Connect or Strava, or imports FIT files, creating one templated note per activity.
